summary: Alterity Therapeutics, an Australian-domiciled development-stage pharmaceutical listed on ASX and NASDAQ, filed a Form 6-K furnishing an ASX announcement setting the date of its next Annual General Meeting for 11:00am AEDT on Friday 20 November 2026 and the closing date for director nominations at 5:00pm AEST on Friday 2 October 2026, per ASX Listing Rule 3.13.1. No transaction, stake, price, recommendation or advisor is disclosed; the filing is a routine meeting and nomination-timing notice. Watch for the separate Notice of Meeting, which will detail the election resolutions and any proxy contest risk.
